summary: Task 2 i18n bootstrap is security-sound: cookie hardened (env-conditional Secure, cookieCrossOrigin:false, explicit cookieKey, SameSite Lax via module default), routeRules header parity for /auth/** and /en/auth/** verified live, NON_DEFAULT_LOCALES parity guard in place, no hardcoded secrets, no typosquat transitive deps. Two info-level observations (vue-i18n@10 upstream-deprecation notice, dual-source locale config surface) — neither blocking.

findings.issue: Transitive dependency `vue-i18n@10.0.8` carries an upstream `deprecated:` flag ("v9 and v10 no longer supported. please migrate to v11"). This is a maintenance/EOL notice from the intlify maintainers, not a published CVE — but a deprecated dependency is a long-term supply-chain risk surface (no future security patches). `@nuxtjs/i18n@9.5.6` peer-pins to vue-i18n v10 so we cannot upgrade to vue-i18n v11 without bumping the Nuxt module to v10 (currently in alpha/beta per intlify roadmap). Out of immediate scope per task prompt; flagged for the Audit-Wave Task 13 to track as a follow-up.
findings.fix: No action in Task 2. Track for Wave 5 / Task 13 (Security Audit): once `@nuxtjs/i18n@^10` reaches stable, plan upgrade path to pull in vue-i18n v11. Until then, continue monitoring https://vue-i18n.intlify.dev/guide/maintenance.html for any v10 emergency patch advisories.

findings.issue: Locale set is declared in two places: `i18n.locales` (full list incl. default) and `NON_DEFAULT_LOCALES` (subset, in shared/i18n-locales.ts). Adding a 3rd locale requires updating BOTH; if a contributor only updates `i18n.locales` (e.g. adds `de`), the routeRules security-headers map silently misses `/de/auth/**` → token-leak regression on the new locale (the very risk the parity guard was designed to prevent for `en`). Not a Task 2 defect — the constant was correctly introduced — but the dual-source surface is the residual risk the guard does not yet cover. Out of immediate scope (Task 4's check-locales script could add this assertion).
findings.fix: Optional defense-in-depth, deferable to Task 4 (`scripts/check-locales.mjs`): assert that every entry in `i18n.locales` whose `code !== defaultLocale` also appears in `NON_DEFAULT_LOCALES`. Or even better — derive `i18n.locales` from a single union object so the two arrays cannot drift. No changes required for Task 2 to ship.

checks_performed.supply_chain: PASS — @nuxtjs/i18n@9.5.6 from official nuxt-modules org (sha512 integrity recorded in lockfile, well-formed). Transitive @intlify/* and vue-i18n@10.0.8 from canonical intlify maintainers. @miyaneee/rollup-plugin-json5@1.2.0 is a known intlify transitive dep (json5 support for locale files). No typosquat-shaped names in 917-line lockfile diff. (Note: pnpm/npm not available in audit sandbox — could not run `pnpm audit`; package origin verified by integrity hash format and known maintainer namespaces.)
checks_performed.cookie_security_AC1_decisions_3_4: PASS — useCookie:true, cookieKey:'i18n_lang' (explicit, not module default i18n_redirected), cookieSecure:process.env.NODE_ENV==='production' (env-conditional), cookieCrossOrigin:false, redirectOn:'no prefix', alwaysRedirect:false, fallbackLocale:'uk'. SameSite Lax is module default per Decision 3. cookieMaxAge correctly omitted (Context7-verified not in v9 API; module default ~1y satisfies user-spec).
checks_performed.token_leak_protection_AC8_decision_14: PASS — routeRules map: '/auth/**' gets {...AUTH_HEADERS}; '/en/auth/**' generated via Object.fromEntries(NON_DEFAULT_LOCALES.map(...)) with same {...AUTH_HEADERS}. Headers identical: X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow + Referrer-Policy: no-referrer. User confirmed via curl on both /auth/login and /en/auth/verify-email?token=x — parity verified live. AUTH_HEADERS named-constant prevents typo divergence between two map entries (defense-in-depth).
checks_performed.parity_guard_AC14_decision_14: PASS — NON_DEFAULT_LOCALES = ['en'] as const is single source for the routeRules generation. Only one literal 'en' exists in nuxt.config.ts (line 31 — inside `i18n.locales` array, the canonical declaration of locale set; not a parity-drift surface for routeRules). routeRules generation iterates NON_DEFAULT_LOCALES — adding a 3rd locale requires updating that constant only (and registering it in i18n.locales — see info finding above on dual-source).
checks_performed.production_warning_suppression_AC15_deci: PASS — i18n.config.ts: silentTranslationWarn and silentFallbackWarn both gated on process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production'. Defense against info disclosure via console (missing-key paths could reveal route/feature internals). In dev mode warnings remain visible for debug.
checks_performed.locale_stub_safety_decision_9: PASS — Stub JSON {"common":{"placeholder":"x"}} contains no __proto__, constructor, or prototype keys. Safe for current consumption (Vue I18n message compiler). Full prototype-pollution mitigation (Object.create(null), key filtering in scripts/check-locales.mjs) correctly deferred to Task 4 per Decision 9.
checks_performed.secrets_in_diff: PASS — Manual scan of 6 modified files: only one ?token= mention (in nuxt.config.ts comment explaining WHY auth pages need noindex/no-referrer headers — documentation of attack vector, not a leaked credential). No API keys, passwords, tokens, private keys, or connection strings. Pre-commit gitleaks-not-installed warning noted — manual diff review confirms clean.
